log_classification_label.title: Log Dataset Classification Label
log_classification_label.description: The formal sensitivity classification label assigned to the operational metadata log dataset as a whole.

aggregate_reclassification_policy_exists.title: Aggregate Reclassification Policy Exists
aggregate_reclassification_policy_exists.description: Indicates whether a formal policy exists that requires log datasets to be reclassified based on their aggregate sensitivity, rather than the sensitivity of individual fields alone.

sensitive_field_types_present.title: Sensitive Field Types Present in Logs
sensitive_field_types_present.description: List of sensitive field categories present in the log dataset that, in combination, enable behavioral profiling or re-identification (e.g., user identifiers, IP addresses, timestamps, session tokens, geolocation).

retention_schedule_defined.title: Retention Schedule Formally Defined
retention_schedule_defined.description: Whether a formal, documented retention schedule exists that specifies how long operational metadata logs must be retained before disposal.

retention_schedule_enforced.title: Retention Schedule Technically Enforced
retention_schedule_enforced.description: Whether the defined retention schedule is enforced by automated technical controls (e.g., log lifecycle policies, automated deletion jobs, SIEM retention rules) rather than relying solely on manual processes.

log_maximum_retention_days.title: Maximum Log Retention Period (Days)
log_maximum_retention_days.description: The configured maximum number of days operational metadata logs are retained before automated deletion or archival. A value of 0 indicates no maximum is configured.

pii_anonymization_policy_applied.title: PII/Quasi-Identifier Anonymization Policy Applied
pii_anonymization_policy_applied.description: Indicates whether a documented anonymization or pseudonymization policy is enforced at log ingestion or storage, covering quasi-identifiers such as usernames, IPs, device IDs, and session tokens. Also serves as a compensating control when field-level encryption is absent.

unmasked_quasi_identifier_fields.title: Unmasked Quasi-Identifier Fields Present in Logs
unmasked_quasi_identifier_fields.description: List of field names confirmed to contain unmasked quasi-identifiers in stored log records, such as 'username', 'source_ip', 'device_id', or 'session_token'.

metadata_access_control_model.title: Metadata Access Control Model
metadata_access_control_model.description: The type of access control applied to the metadata aggregate collection. Indicates whether access is role-agnostic, coarse-grained, or fine-grained with role and purpose enforcement.

field_level_access_control_enabled.title: Field-Level Access Control Enabled
field_level_access_control_enabled.description: Whether the metadata store enforces field-level or column-level access controls, preventing low-privilege roles from reading sensitive fields such as user identifiers, IP addresses, or timing data.

purpose_bound_export_controls_enforced.title: Purpose-Bound Export Controls Enforced
purpose_bound_export_controls_enforced.description: Whether exports or bulk queries of the full metadata aggregate require explicit purpose justification and approval, preventing unrestricted bulk extraction by any authorized reader.

field_level_encryption_enabled.title: Field-Level Encryption Enabled
field_level_encryption_enabled.description: Indicates whether field-level or column-level encryption is applied to sensitive log fields within the log repository.

cross_border_transfer_enabled.title: Cross-Border Metadata Transfer Enabled
cross_border_transfer_enabled.description: Indicates whether operational metadata logs are replicated or exported to systems or storage located in foreign jurisdictions.

transfer_legal_basis.title: Legal Basis for Cross-Border Transfer
transfer_legal_basis.description: The legal mechanism authorizing the cross-border transfer of operational metadata (e.g., adequacy decision, standard contractual clauses, binding corporate rules, consent, none).

metadata_contains_individual_identifiers.title: Metadata Contains Individual or System Identifiers
metadata_contains_individual_identifiers.description: Indicates whether the operational metadata dataset includes identifiers (e.g., user IDs, IP addresses, device IDs, session tokens) that can be linked to individuals or regulated systems in jurisdictions with data localization requirements.

formal_disposal_procedure_documented.title: Formal Disposal Procedure Documented
formal_disposal_procedure_documented.description: Whether a formally documented and approved procedure exists for the secure disposal of expired or superseded log data, including defined triggers, methods, and responsible parties.

disposal_method.title: Log Disposal Method
disposal_method.description: The technical method used to delete or destroy expired log data. Logical deletion leaves data recoverable; cryptographic erasure or physical destruction provides stronger guarantees.

disposal_attestation_records_maintained.title: Disposal Attestation Records Maintained
disposal_attestation_records_maintained.description: Whether verifiable attestation records (certificates of destruction or audit trail entries) are generated and retained for each log disposal event, providing evidence of compliant data destruction.
